scope: OOD only; all 13 held-out families on RouterBench and SPROUT; existing frozen splits and penalty grids
prediction: Separate arithmetic means of per-model recorded reward and total USD cost; no new tuning or fitted head
primary_metrics: Query- and model-weighted MSE for reward and cost, in separate units. Relative error reduction versus GTE and source-model training mean to compare changes across targets.
secondary_metrics: MAE; per-query across-model centered MSE and MAE; per-model and per-family breakdowns; equal-family summaries
format_control: For each test query use the 100 nearest GTE training queries with the same existing coarse answer-format label as that query. No held-out family queries. This is a known-format diagnostic, not a deployability or causal identification claim.
retrieval: Original float32 unit normalization and common.nearest exact cosine, stable row-index ties, no parameter search
hybrids: All four GTE/L21 reward and cost combinations, with argmax(predicted reward - lambda predicted cost); plus format-filtered GTE and source-mean references. No clipping or second cost subtraction.
uncertainty: Existing paired bootstrap: 2000 within-held-out-family query draws, same draws across methods/metrics and penalties; mean over penalties inside replicates; fixed fitted routers and benchmark families
controls: Reuse exact audited original kNN100 reward/cost predictions. Reconstruct all original choices and scores. New format-restricted predictions recorded with neighbor identities. No manuscript edits.
